required_forms.description: PF withdrawal by nominee on death of member
required_forms.notes: Must be attested by the last employer
Sets up monthly pension for eligible nominee. Separate from PF lump sum.

required_forms.description: Nominee claim when no nomination exists
required_forms.condition: Only if no nominee was registered by the deceased member

required_documents.doc: Bank passbook or cancelled cheque of nominee

required_documents.notes: EPFO can process WITHOUT PAN if nominee Aadhaar is furnished — key advantage over banks

procedure_steps: Contact HR of deceased's last employer to obtain UAN
Confirm nominee registration on UAN portal — critical before proceeding
Download Form 20 and Form 10-D from epfindia.gov.in
Get both forms attested and stamped by the last employer
Submit complete set at nearest EPFO regional office in person
Collect acknowledgement slip with claim reference number
Track at epfindia.gov.in > Our Services > For Employees > Track Claim
PF lump sum credited in 30 days. EPS pension starts from next month after approval.
common_rejection_reasons: UAN not seeded with Aadhaar — visit EPFO office to resolve
Employer not attested the forms — follow up with HR
Nominee not registered — Form 51F required instead
Bank account mismatch — account number and IFSC must be correct

special_cases.pan_missing: EPFO does NOT require PAN of deceased if nominee Aadhaar is furnished. Proceed without PAN — unique advantage.
special_cases.employer_not_cooperating: File grievance at epfigms.gov.in. EPFO can directly process claim after grievance acknowledgement.
special_cases.no_nominee_registered: Use Form 51F. Legal heir certificate required. All family members must apply jointly.
special_cases.uан_unknown: Contact last employer HR. If company is closed, approach regional EPFO office with employment proof.
